mapper.update: UPDATE member_activity SET issued_count = issued_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND issued_count < #{maxIssueCount}
mapper.select: SELECT ma.id, ma.type, ma.status AS act_status, ma.start_time, ma.end_time, ma.scope, ma.available_num, ma.coupon_id, ma.author_id, ma.limited_num, ma.claim_way, ma.claim_type, ci.author_ids, ma.user_ids, ci.coupon_name, ci.coupon_type, ci.threshold_amount, ci.discount_amount, ci.effective_type, ci.effective_days, ci.expiration_days, ci.max_issue_count, ci.issued_count, ci.used_count FROM member_activity ma INNER JOIN coupon_info ci ON ma.coupon_id = ci.id AND ci.deleted = 0 WHERE ma.deleted = 0 AND ma.status = 0 AND ma.claim_way = 2 AND ma.start_time <= NOW() AND ma.end_time >= NOW()
